seam 2 blog: sitemap 8 locs = 2 roots + 6 posts, 1:1 with posts.js; feed.xml 6 entries valid Atom; meta.mjs check run = 13 ok, 0 stale; section labels match 2/2/2; hello-lew42 part3 shows prev-part + next-post (not contradictory); reading times on all 6 cards; 0 console errors. seam 6 stream/json: CLEAN. rpc:append answers 'append successful' for a .jsonl inside this task dir, 'append refused' for a .txt and for ../../../etc/evil.jsonl, 'append empty' for []; rpc:ls answers. Counts match disk exactly: wire 1 lines/93B, blocks 0 lines/0B + 3 blocks, cms/json/edit 2 lines/426 bytes. All 7 data files 200. WORST FINDING - core/Page/doc carries 3 live anchors that 404: doc/layout.md:74 -> /framework/core/Page/old/overview/columns/ (that page.js was deleted today; the live demo is now /framework/core/Page/overview/columns/), doc/roles.md:75 -> /framework/core/Page/doc/method/nearest/ (pretty form; should be nearest.md), doc/findings.md:54 -> /imagine/decks/doc/regions/ (pretty form; decks/page.js warns about exactly this trap). Each renders the visible '404 - nothing matches' page.

console sweep: 950 urls link-crawled from / on the private port (cms/edit + vary/colstyles skipped). 80 error urls, all re-verified one at a time: 26 are the /alex/ /castin/ /edric/ sandbox dirs (pre-existing Page.activate TypeError, core was only added to today), 5 are pre-2026-08-31 ai task pages, 15 were my own crawler resolving relative hrefs against /, and the rest were ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES from 8 concurrent tabs and passed on a single-tab revisit. assign.outcome:
**Five seams clean, one finding.** Read-only QA over today's 7 waves, driven headless on a private :8097 (torn down).

**Worst finding - 3 dead links in `core/Page/doc/`, all rendering the visible 404 page.**
- `doc/layout.md:74` -> `/framework/core/Page/old/overview/columns/` - that demo's `page.js` was deleted today and `columns` dropped from `old/overview/page.js` `children:`. The live one is `/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/` (loads, 3218 chars).
- `doc/roles.md:75` -> `/framework/core/Page/doc/method/nearest/` - the pretty form; should be `nearest.md`.
- `doc/findings.md:54` -> `/imagine/decks/doc/regions/` - same trap `decks/page.js` warns about in a comment.

**Clean, with numbers.** Generator: save + look + reload all survive one store key (`sized gapped looked hash saved`); saved spec + ink + `#s=` address hold together; unknown-word hint fires; export row 365px inside a 397px column at 400vw. Blog: sitemap 8 locs = 2 roots + 6 posts, 1:1 with `posts.js`; feed 6 entries; `meta.mjs` 13 ok / 0 stale; hello-lew42 part 3 draws prev-part + next-post, not contradictory. Decks: numeral correct on all 6 cuts + pitch (6) + swap (4); Space never scrolls (page is exactly one viewport). Mag: prev absent only on 01, 'End of issue' only on 06. seed-7: 16/16 pages walk. stream/json: `rpc:append` 'append successful' in-dir, 'refused' for `.txt` and `../../../etc/`; counts match disk exactly.

**Sweep: 950 urls.** 80 error urls, all re-verified singly - 26 sandbox dirs, 5 old ai pages, 15 crawler artifacts, the rest concurrency noise. New error urls = the 3 above.
